snippet.title: Valor of Man is -THE- RPG roguelite for dark fantasy tacticians.
snippet.description:
OUT NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2699280/Valor_of_Man/

Forge your party. Master your fate. In this turn-based roguelite RPG, lead four heroes through a fractured realm of danger and destiny. Build synergies, unlock powerful abilities, and face ever-shifting challenges in an epic battle for survival. No journey is ever the same.
